push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Creamsters | You: 10.0 (top 10% FOR)
push.body:
Well, butter my biscuit, PhogsToffees. A 10.0. Folks in the top 10% of forwards don't play much better than that.

DID WELL
+ 93% passing on 29 attempts, up from your usual 72%. Every pass had a return address on it.
+ 5 shots at FC Creamsters's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ 2 goals from 3 on target. Ice in the veins, honey in the heart.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). That's what I call neighborly football.
+ A brace against FC Creamsters, your 2nd straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.

WORK ON
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
- 4 missed tackles shaved 0.1 off. Clean that up and you're flying.

Coach's drill: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 1 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 22/34 passes (65%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

coach.opener: BellyTb1, that was a 9.3. Top-ten-percent stuff for a midfielder anywhere in this league. I'd frame it if I knew how.

push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Creamsters | You: 9.3 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, I've seen sunsets in Kansas less beautiful than that 9.3. Top 10% for a midfielder.

DID WELL
+ 34 passes, your busiest match yet. You were the hub, and hubs keep wheels turning.
+ A brace against FC Creamsters, your 4th straight match scoring. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ 1 key pass. You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ 1.3 better than usual. That's a staircase, and you're climbing it.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
- 65% passing (22 of 34). Tell you what: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- 3 shots off target cost 0.1. Think of it as a pebble in your boot. Shake it out.
- 3 goals conceded pulled you down 0.1. That's the low-hanging fruit.

This week's homework: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso

talk.opener: That's a W. 4-3 against FC Creamsters, and I'm smiling so big it hurts.
